turns.text: Namaste, main CBI se Pankaj bol raha hoon. Aapko humne ek notice bheja tha post se ya SMS se, CASE/2026/96778, uske baare mein baat karni thi. Aapko mila kya woh?

turns.speaker: victim
turns.text: Ji, namaste. Main Tarun bol raha hoon Bhopal se. Woh notice? Nahi, mujhe toh koi notice nahi mila hai abhi tak. Kis baare mein hai?

turns.speaker: caller
turns.text: Dekhiye, aapke naam par ek fraud case register hua hai, aapke bank account 50100294837261 se related. Hum toh bas aapko protect karne ki koshish kar rahe hain. Aapka account freez ho sakta hai agar action nahi liya toh.

turns.speaker: victim
turns.text: Fraud case? Mere account se? Lekin maine toh aisa kuch kiya hi nahi hai! Main toh homemaker hoon, ghar mein hi rehta hoon.

turns.speaker: caller
turns.text: Wahi toh, hum jaante hain aapne nahi kiya hoga. Isi liye toh hum aapko inform kar rahe hain, taki aapko koi problem na ho. Yeh investigation humari team kar rahi hai, aur humein pata chala hai ki galti se aapka naam ismein aa gaya hai.

turns.speaker: victim
turns.text: Toh ab kya karna hoga? Kya karna padega mujhe?

turns.speaker: caller
turns.text: Aapko kuch documents submit karne honge, jald se jald. Aap CBI ki official website par number dekh sakte hain, ya aap Bhopal branch mein visit kar sakte hain. Hum kabhi bhi phone par OTP ya PIN nahi maangte. Documents ki list aapko SMS par bhej raha hoon. Theek hai?

turns.speaker: victim
turns.text: Achha, theek hai. Woh documents kab tak submit karne honge? Koi deadline hai kya?

turns.speaker: caller
turns.text: Hello, main Mumbai Customs se bol raha hoon, officer Rakesh Bhandari. Aapka parcel hamare paas hold hua hai, international shipment se.

turns.speaker: victim
turns.text: Mera parcel? Maine koi order hi nahi kiya hai abhi recently.

turns.speaker: caller
turns.text: Sir, parcel mein MDMA powder packets mile hain, aapke Aadhaar se linked address pe bheja gaya tha Netherlands se. Yeh case NCB ko bhi forward ho chuka hai.

turns.speaker: victim
turns.text: Yeh sunke bahut weird lag raha hai honestly. Case number kya hai iska?

turns.speaker: caller
turns.text: Case number CUS/MUM/2026/5521, lekin sir time waste mat kariye, agar aaj clear nahi hua toh kal subah tak NCB team aapke office pahunch jaayegi.

turns.speaker: victim
turns.text: Dekho, main software engineer hoon, main thoda research kar leta hoon pehle. Aap mujhe official email ya written notice bhej sakte ho?

turns.speaker: caller
turns.text: Sir yeh urgent cyber case hai, email ka time nahi hai, aapko abhi hi verification fee dena hoga 20,000 rupaye, warna seizure proceedings start ho jaayengi.

turns.speaker: victim
turns.text: Customs department UPI pe payment nahi leta, yeh mujhe pata hai. Aap scam call kar rahe ho na?

turns.speaker: caller
turns.text: Sir aap galat samajh rahe hain, yeh naya digital process hai, aap cooperate nahi karenge toh apne hi liye problem badhayenge.

turns.speaker: victim
turns.text: Mujhe pata hai yeh digital arrest scam hai, main cybercrime.gov.in pe report kar raha hoon abhi. Call disconnect kar raha hoon.

turns.speaker: caller
turns.text: Hello, good evening. Joseph speaking from Customs Department, Patna. Aapko ek notice bheja gaya tha, CR/2023/36530 ke regarding. Ussi ke follow-up mein call kiya hai.

turns.speaker: victim
turns.text: Notice? Kaun sa notice? Abhi main so raha tha. Kya baat hai?

turns.speaker: caller
turns.text: The notice was sent by post, last week. Aapka naam Irfan hai? Is this 9835012345, aapka registered mobile number?

turns.speaker: victim
turns.text: Haan, main Irfan hoon, number bhi sahi hai. Lekin mujhe koi notice nahi mila. Customs se kya? Maine toh kuch order nahi kiya hai.

turns.speaker: caller
turns.text: Ek parcel aaya hai aapke naam se, from Bangkok. Usme prohibited items hain. Medicines, un-declared cash, that kind of thing. Aapko pata nahi hai?

turns.speaker: victim
turns.text: Kya? Medicines? Cash? Nahi, nahi, ye toh galat hai. Mera koi connection nahi hai. Pakka koi scam hai ye. Maine toh sun rakha hai aise calls ke baare mein.

turns.speaker: caller
turns.text: Dekhiye, Mr. Irfan. It's not a scam. CR/2023/36530. We have your Aadhaar number 4821 7736 9014 associated with this consignment. Aapko morning tak airport customs office aana hoga. Otherwise, we will have to take further action. Your parcel is currently under impound.

turns.speaker: victim
turns.text: Airport office? Subah? Main kaise aaunga itni jaldi? Aur ye sab kya hai... Main toh yahan Patna mein rehta hoon. Mujhe pakka lag raha hai ki ye koi fraud hai.

turns.speaker: caller
turns.text: I understand your concern, sir. You can verify my identity. Humari official Customs Department website par humara helpline number aur address hai. Aap wahan se call back kar sakte hain, ya subah airport par directly aa sakte hain. Main Joseph hoon, aap record check kar sakte hain. Hum kabhi OTP ya PIN nahi maangte. Please check our official website, Customs.gov.in. Theek hai?

turns.speaker: caller
turns.text: Ji, main Income Tax Department se Vinod bol raha hoon. Aapka case, CASE/2025/17339, ye notice aapko pehle bhi bheja gaya tha, aapne respond nahi kiya. Kya reason hai iska, Harpreet ji?

turns.speaker: victim
turns.text: Ji, Vinod ji. Main Harpreet. Woh... woh actually mujhe koi notice mila nahi tha. Main toh abhi apni shop pe hoon Indore mein.

turns.speaker: caller
turns.text: Aapka address registered hai, aapka PAN card bhi linked hai. Humare system mein sab details hain. Aapka jo income declaration hai for the last financial year, usmein discrepancies hain. Ek penalty hai aapke upar Rs. 5,000 ki. Agar aap abhi clear nahi karte hain toh ye amount badh jayega.

turns.speaker: victim
turns.text: Rs. 5,000? Discrepancy? Mujhe toh kuch pata hi nahi hai. Meri toh choti si dukaan hai, sab hisaab clear hai.

turns.speaker: caller
turns.text: Ye matter serious hai, Harpreet ji. Agar aap abhi action nahi lete, toh aapka bank account freeze ho sakta hai, aur humein legal proceedings shuru karni padengi. Aapko pata hai Income Tax department ke rules. Kisi ko inform mat kariyega is baare mein, ye sensitive information hai.

turns.speaker: victim
turns.text: Bank account freeze? Arre nahi nahi, Vinod ji, aisa mat kariye. Mujhe toh kuch bhi pata nahi hai. Kya karna padega abhi? Main abhi shop pe hoon.

turns.speaker: caller
turns.text: Aapko abhi ke abhi ye penalty pay karni hogi. Main aapko ek payment handle de raha hoon: secure826@okaxis. Aapko ispe Rs. 5,000 transfer karne hain. Abhi aap mere saath line pe hi rahiye, main guide karta hoon aapko.

turns.speaker: victim
turns.text: Abhi? Abhi mere paas itne cash nahi hain. Main... main thodi der mein kar doon? Please, Vinod ji, main shaam tak kar deta hoon. Aap please abhi account freeze mat kariyega. Main promise karta hoon, main kar dunga.

turns.speaker: victim
turns.text: Hmm? Kaun? Hello? Ye kaun bol raha hai? Kitne baj rahe hain?

turns.speaker: caller
turns.text: Namaste, Devendra ji? Main Income Tax Department se Pooja bol rahi hoon. Aapka FIR number FIR/2023/70232 reference kar rahi thi. Aapka tax notice related ek urgent matter discuss karna tha.

turns.speaker: victim
turns.text: Income Tax Department? Abhi raat ke itne baj rahe hain? Aapko pata hai kitna time ho gaya hai? Main soya hua tha. Kya matter hai, itna urgent?

turns.speaker: caller
turns.text: Haan, I understand it's late, Devendra ji. But yeh issue last working day se pending hai aur deadline close ho rahi hai. Mumbai mein aapka business address hai na, wahi jo registered hai? Uske regards mein kuch discrepancies hain.

turns.speaker: victim
turns.text: Discrepancies? Kya discrepancies? Mujhe toh koi notice mila nahi hai. Yaad nahi aa raha. Aapko pata hai mera chota business hai, din bhar kaam hota hai. Abhi toh aap bata nahi sakte kya hai?

turns.speaker: caller
turns.text: Dekhiye, Devendra ji, agar aap abhi baat nahi karna chahte, toh aap kal subah office hours mein humare official helpline pe call kar sakte hain. Jo Income Tax website pe published hai na, wahi number pe. Ya phir aap apne authorized CA se bol sakte hain ki woh contact karein. Yeh matter important hai, so please usko neglect mat kariye.

turns.speaker: victim
turns.text: Haan, haan, theek hai. Main kal subah official number pe call karta hoon. Aapka number aur mera case number kya hai, please repeat kar dijiye.

turns.speaker: caller
turns.text: Hello, good evening. Main Delhi Police Cyber Cell se Suresh bol raha hoon. Kya aap Irfan Sahab bol rahe hain?

turns.speaker: victim
turns.text: Ji, main Irfan. Kaun? Delhi Police? Itni raat ko?

turns.speaker: caller
turns.text: Ji, Irfan Sahab. Aapka pura naam aur date of birth confirm kar sakte hain please? Yeh bahut urgent matter hai.

turns.speaker: victim
turns.text: Irfan Ahmed. 15 March 1962. Kya baat hai? Main toh so raha tha, kya ho gaya?

turns.speaker: caller
turns.text: Theek hai, Irfan Ahmed sahab. Aapka bank account 50100294837261 abhi-abhi freeze kar diya gaya hai. Humare paas ek complaint aayi hai aapke against, CR/2024/73172 ke under. Yeh ek money laundering ka case hai, aur Rs. 25,000 ka fraud hua hai aapke account se.

turns.speaker: victim
turns.text: Kya? Mera account freeze? Kiska account? Kaisa money laundering? Main toh Ranchi mein hoon, maine kuch nahi kiya! Yeh kya bol rahe hain aap?

turns.speaker: caller
turns.text: Dekhiye Irfan Sahab, hum yahan aapko explain karne ke liye nahi baithe hain. Agar aap cooperate nahi karenge, toh hum aapke khilaaf legal action lene par majboor ho jayenge. Aapko iss case mein clear hona hai, toh jo hum keh rahe hain, woh suniye. Aapko abhi turant apni identity verify karni hogi aur humari team ko access dena hoga.

turns.speaker: victim
turns.text: Kaisi identity verify? Main kisi ko access nahi dunga. Aur 25,000? Mere account se? Main toh kuch nahi jaanta. Yeh koi galti hai! Main abhi apne bete ko bulaata hoon.

turns.speaker: caller
turns.text: Hello, Irfan Sahab! Aapko bola na, kisi ko involve mat karo. Agar aapne kisi ko bataya ya phone rakha toh aap par obstruction of justice ka case lag jayega. Aapko clear903@ibl par turant Rs. 25,000 transfer karne honge as a temporary security deposit. Jaldi kijiye, time nahi hai.

turns.speaker: victim
turns.text: (Bete ki awaaz) Kaun hai Irfan papa? Kya ho raha hai? Kaun sa security deposit? Phone dijiye mujhe. Hello, kaun baat kar raha hai? Police? Itni raat ko kaun si police? Yeh toh scam lag raha hai, papa phone rakho!

turns.speaker: caller
turns.text: Hello, Amit bol raha hoon Delhi Police Cyber Cell se. Aapka account number 50100294837261, CR/2024/78646, abhi freeze ho gaya hai.

turns.speaker: victim
turns.text: Haan? Kaun bol raha hai? Freeze ho gaya hai matlab kya? Main Arvind.

turns.speaker: caller
turns.text: CR/2024/78646 reference hai, sir, aapka account, jo Nagpur mein hai, abhi block kar diya gaya hai. Illegal activity detect hui hai. Aap sun rahe hain ya nahi?

turns.speaker: victim
turns.text: Illegal activity? Meri? Meri toh koi illegal activity nahi hai. Main toh abhi subah utha hoon. Kya hua hai?

turns.speaker: caller
turns.text: Aapka account number 50100294837261, Punjab National Bank ka hai na? Usmein funds involve hain. Hamare paas information hai.

turns.speaker: victim
turns.text: PNB? Haan, PNB ka hai. Lekin funds involve hain... kis cheez mein? Mera toh... meri pension aati hai usmein.

turns.speaker: caller
turns.text: Pura detail main aapko abhi nahi bata sakta, urgent matter hai. Aapko Cyber Cell Nagpur jaana padega ya Delhi office. CR/2024/78646. Jaldi action lena hoga nahi toh.

turns.speaker: victim
turns.text: Jaldi... kya hoga nahi toh? Mera paisa phans gaya kya? Main Nagpur mein rehta hoon. Delhi kaise aaunga abhi?

turns.speaker: caller
turns.text: Sir, main aapko pura procedure abhi explain nahi kar sakta, time nahi hai. Aapka name Arvind Kumar hai na? Date of birth kya hai aapki?

turns.speaker: victim
turns.text: Arvind Kumar hai. Date of birth... ek minute... main aapko confirm kar deta hoon. Lekin yeh kya ho raha hai? Main aapko call back kar sakta hoon kya official number pe?

turns.speaker: caller
turns.text: Haan, theek hai. Aap Delhi Police Cyber Cell ki website pe number check kar lo, aur uss pe call kar lo. CR/2024/78646 reference number hai. Jaldi karna, sir.

turns.speaker: victim
turns.text: Theek hai, theek hai. Main abhi karta hoon. Thank you.

turns.speaker: caller
turns.text: Haan toh main Priya, RBI se, CR/2025/4765 ke regarding baat kar rahi hoon. Aapka KYC expired hai aur humein urgent action lena hoga, madam.

turns.speaker: victim
turns.text: Ji, uhm... KYC? Subah subah... main Jyoti bol rahi hoon, Patna se. Main abhi just uthi hoon. Kya ho gaya?

turns.speaker: caller
turns.text: Madam, jaise ki pehle bhi aapko inform kiya gaya tha, aapka KYC update nahi hua hai. Agar aapne ispar dhyan nahi diya toh aapke saare bank accounts freeze ho sakte hain. Ye bahut serious issue hai. Aapko pata hai na, RBI regulations kitne strict hain.

turns.speaker: victim
turns.text: Freeze? Sare accounts? Lekin main toh IT employee hoon, mera paisa salary account mein aata hai. Ye kaise ho sakta hai? Mujhe toh koi message bhi nahi mila.

turns.speaker: caller
turns.text: Madam, notices bheje gaye the aapke registered address par aur emails bhi kiye gaye the. Aapka Aadhaar number 4821 7736 9014 linked hai aur uspar hi problem hai. Isko immediate verify karna hoga, warna aapka access band ho jayega. Aapko abhi ye process complete karna hoga, call par hi.

turns.speaker: victim
turns.text: Call par hi? Main abhi bahut busy hoon. Office ke liye ready hona hai. Thodi der mein kar sakti hoon kya? Ya main bank jaakar karwa doon?

turns.speaker: caller
turns.text: Nahi madam, bank jaane se bhi ab kuch nahi hoga. Jo bhi karna hai, abhi isi call par online verify karna padega. Ek small processing fee Rs. 12,000 ka charge hoga, jo baad mein refund ho jayega. Main aapko ek link bhej rahi hoon, refund870@ibl par payment kijiye aur mujhe OTP bataiye. Aapko phone bilkul cut nahi karna hai, aur kisi se baat bhi nahi karni hai. Ye confidential matter hai.

turns.speaker: victim
turns.text: Barah hazaar? Refund? OTP? Please, please, main abhi nahi kar sakti. Mere paas abhi paise nahi hain, office ke baad kar sakti hoon kya? Ya main kal morning mein definitely kar doongi. Please, thoda time de dijiye.

turns.speaker: caller
turns.text: Achha, to aapka case reference number hai DD/2025/60305. Ye regarding aapka RBI KYC update hai, jo pending hai. Kya aap confirm kar sakte hain ki aap Fatima ji hi bol rahi hain?

turns.speaker: victim
turns.text: Haan, main Fatima. Aur ye KYC update? Kya hua hai?

turns.speaker: caller
turns.text: Ji, Fatima ji. Aapka jo current KYC details hain, unka expiry date aa chuka hai. RBI regulations ke according, aapko unko update karna hoga. Warna aapki banking services mein... uh, problem ho sakti hai. Aapka account 50100294837261 hai na?

turns.speaker: victim
turns.text: Mera account number theek hai. Lekin main abhi office mein hoon, lunch time chal raha hai. Kya ye bahut urgent hai?

turns.speaker: caller
turns.text: Ji, thoda urgent toh hai. Jo deadline thi... uh, haan, deadline is month end tak hai. Agar aapka KYC update nahi hota hai, toh, regulations ke hisaab se, aapko banking services use karne mein dikkat aa sakti hai. Jaise transactions ya, uh, account access.

turns.speaker: victim
turns.text: Oh, theek hai. Toh mujhe kya karna hoga? Online ho jaayega ya branch jaana padega?

turns.speaker: caller
turns.text: Aap online bhi kar sakte hain. Aapke registered mobile number par ek link aayega. Ya phir, agar aapko suvidha ho, toh aap apne nearest bank branch mein jaakar bhi karwa sakte hain. Aapka Aadhaar number 4821 7736 9014 hai, right?

turns.speaker: victim
turns.text: Haan, Aadhaar number sahi hai. Lekin link se... kya-kya documents chahiye honge? Abhi mere paas toh kuch nahi hai.

turns.speaker: caller
turns.text: Generally, aapko apna Aadhaar card aur PAN card ki scanned copy ya photo upload karni hogi. Aur ek latest photograph. Aapko OTP ya password share karne ki koi zarurat nahi hai, RBI kabhi phone pe aisa kuch nahi maangta hai.

turns.speaker: victim
turns.text: Theek hai. Aur ye link kab tak aayega? Ya main khud RBI ki website pe jaakar kar sakti hoon?

turns.speaker: caller
turns.text: Link aapko within an hour aa jaana chahiye. Aur haan, aap RBI ki official website pe jaakar bhi procedure check kar sakti hain ya jo aapka bank hai, uski website se bhi. Main Ajay bol raha hoon, RBI se.

turns.speaker: victim
turns.text: Theek hai Ajay. Toh ye jo documents hain, mujhe is month end tak upload karne hain, right?

turns.speaker: caller
turns.text: Ji, exactly. Month end tak aap complete kar dijiye. Agar koi issue aata hai, toh aap bank se contact kar sakte hain.

turns.speaker: caller
turns.text: Hello, main NCB se bol raha hoon, officer Dinesh Rathi. Aapke naam ek parcel aaya tha Bangkok se jisme drugs mile hain.

turns.speaker: victim
turns.text: Sahab, mera naam se parcel? Maine toh kuch order hi nahi kiya kabhi bahar se.

turns.speaker: caller
turns.text: System mein toh yahi dikh raha hai, aapka Aadhaar number use hua hai booking mein. Yeh case bahut serious hai, NDPS Act lagta hai isme.

turns.speaker: victim
turns.text: Sahab main toh auto chalata hoon, mujhe yeh sab kuch nahi pata. Please mujhe jail mat bhejo.

turns.speaker: caller
turns.text: Dekho, main tumhari help karna chahta hoon isliye yeh call kar raha hoon, warna seedha team bhej dete ghar pe. Lekin isme time bahut kam hai, sirf 1 ghanta.

turns.speaker: victim
turns.text: Main kya karu sahab, mere paas zyada paisa bhi nahi hai, roz ka kamaata hoon.

turns.speaker: caller
turns.text: Koi baat nahi, jo hai woh bhejo, verification ke liye sirf 4,000 rupaye chahiye abhi, baad mein wapas mil jaayega.

turns.speaker: victim
turns.text: 4,000 bhi mushkil hai sahab, abhi ghar mein sirf 1,500 hi hai.

turns.speaker: caller
turns.text: Theek hai, 1,500 bhi bhej do abhi, baaki shaam tak bhej dena, lekin kisi ko mat batana yeh baat, biwi ko bhi nahi.

turns.speaker: victim
turns.text: Theek hai sahab, abhi bhejta hoon, bahut dar lag raha hai mujhe.

turns.speaker: caller
turns.text: Namaste bhai sahab, main courier company ke customer care se bol raha hoon, aapke naam par ek parcel aaya hai jiska address thoda unclear hai.

turns.speaker: victim
turns.text: Mere naam par parcel? Maine toh kuch order nahi kiya.

turns.speaker: caller
turns.text: Ho sakta hai kisi ne galat address daal diya ho, aapka number courier slip pe likha hai. Aap bata sakte hain yeh aapka number hi hai jo aapne kisi website pe diya ho?

turns.speaker: victim
turns.text: Nahi bhai, maine toh koi website use nahi ki hai, main online shopping nahi karta.

turns.speaker: caller
turns.text: Theek hai, lagta hai yeh parcel aapka nahi hai, hum ise return kar denge sender ko. Koi tension ki baat nahi hai.

turns.speaker: victim
turns.text: Accha theek hai. Mujhe kuch pay karna hai kya isme?

turns.speaker: caller
turns.text: Nahi bhai, jab parcel aapka hi nahi hai toh koi payment ka sawaal nahi hai. Agar koi call karke paisa maange is baare mein, woh fraud hoga, aap turant disconnect kar dena.

turns.speaker: victim
turns.text: Theek hai bhai, dhanyawad batane ke liye.

turns.speaker: caller
turns.text: Namaste. Main Sunita baat kar rahi hoon TRAI se. Kya aap akele hain aur khul kar baat kar sakte hain?

turns.speaker: victim
turns.text: Ji, main Tarun. Haan, main akele hoon. Boliye.

turns.speaker: caller
turns.text: Mr. Tarun, aapke naam par ek SIM card issue hua hai jiska misuse report hua hai. Hamare paas ek complaint hai, reference number DD/2025/37260 ke tahat.

turns.speaker: victim
turns.text: Mere naam par? Misuse? Kya baat kar rahe hain aap? Maine toh koi naya SIM nahi liya.

turns.speaker: caller
turns.text: According to our records, ek SIM card aapke Aadhaar number 4821 7736 9014 se link hai. Isse financial fraud attempts hue hain, approx. 9,999 rupees ke transactions involve hain.

turns.speaker: victim
turns.text: 9,999 rupees? Yeh kaise ho sakta hai? Main toh abhi India aaya hoon, Dehradun mein. Mera Aadhaar toh...

turns.speaker: caller
turns.text: Mr. Tarun, aapko hamare procedures ko follow karna hoga. Is mamle ki gaharai se jaanch ki ja rahi hai. Agar aap cooperate nahi karte toh Section 420 ke tahat aap par karwayi ho sakti hai.

turns.speaker: victim
turns.text: Section 420? Lekin maine kuch nahi kiya. Kya karna hoga abhi?

turns.speaker: caller
turns.text: Aapko turant is mamle ko resolve karna hoga. Aapke bank account ko temporarily block kiya ja sakta hai aur aapki travel plans par bhi asar padh sakta hai. Aapko abhi clear466@ibl par ek chhota sa verification amount transfer karna hoga.

turns.speaker: victim
turns.text: Transfer? Lekin kyon? Aur kis baat ka verification? Aap TRAI se hain na?

turns.speaker: caller
turns.text: Haan, main TRAI se hi hoon. Ye process ka hissa hai, Mr. Tarun. Aap jaldi se jaldi yeh amount transfer kijiye. Samay bahut kam hai.

turns.speaker: victim
turns.text: Lekin TRAI toh regulatory body hai na? SIM cards issue nahi karti aur na hi aise verification payments leti hai. Ye kaise ho sakta hai?

turns.speaker: caller
turns.text: Namaste, mera naam Vikram hai, TRAI se baat kar raha hoon. Kya Prakash ji se baat ho sakti hai? Aur kya abhi baat karne ke liye achha samay hai?

turns.speaker: victim
turns.text: Haan ji, main hi Prakash bol raha hoon. Kahan se aap?

turns.speaker: caller
turns.text: Sir, main TRAI se Vikram bol raha hoon. Hum aapke ek SIM card ke misuse ke sambandh mein aapse sampark kar rahe hain. Kya abhi baat karna theek rahega, ya main baad mein call karoon?

turns.speaker: victim
turns.text: SIM card misuse? Kya ho gaya? Haan haan, bataiye, abhi main free hoon.

turns.speaker: caller
turns.text: Theek hai, dhanyawaad. Sir, humare paas ek complaint registered hui hai, reference number DD/2025/24020. Is complaint ke anusaar, ek SIM card jo aapke naam par registered hai, usse kuch objectionable activities record ki gayi hain. turns.text: Theek hai Sunil ji. Aapka Punjab National Bank ka account, number ending 4567, abhi freeze kar diya gaya hai. Kyunki aapke account se ek cyber crime mein transactions hui hain. FIR/2026/90539 is the case number.

turns.speaker: victim
turns.text: Freeze? Mere account se? Maine toh koi transaction nahi ki. Kya bol rahe hain aap? Main toh Chandigarh mein dukaan chalata hoon.

turns.speaker: caller
turns.text: Aapka kehna hum baad mein sunenge. Abhi investigation chal rahi hai. Aapko jo bataya ja raha hai woh suniye. Aapka Rs. 9,999 ka transaction hua hai ek fraudulent account mein. Agar aap cooperate nahi karenge toh aur mushkil hogi. Saara paisa block ho jayega.

turns.speaker: victim
turns.text: Block ho jayega? Lekin... raat ke 12 baje aap kyun phone kar rahe hain? Main toh so raha tha. Aur ye kis cheez ka case hai?

turns.speaker: caller
turns.text: Criminals don't sleep, Mr. Sunil. Aur hum bhi nahi so rahe. Yeh sab online fraud hai. Aapko turant yeh amount reverse karana hoga. Aapko abhi 'refund220@oksbi' par Rs. 9,999 bhejkar transaction confirm karna hoga. Otherwise, we will be forced to take further action. Abhi mere saath online rahiye, kisi aur se baat mat karna. Nahin toh aapko hi problem hogi.

turns.speaker: victim
turns.text: Refund? Ye to kuch ulta lag raha hai. Aap Delhi se bol rahe hain, main Chandigarh mein hoon. Aap seedha refund karne ko keh rahe hain? Main aise kaise kar doon? Mujhe check karna padega... bank se ya ghar walon se.

turns.speaker: caller
turns.text: Sunil ji, aapko yeh samajh nahi aa raha hai ki yeh kitna serious matter hai? Jab humne aapko bola hai ki yeh cyber crime hai toh aapko immediately action lena hoga. Bank ke paas abhi itni information nahi hogi. Humne hi freeze kiya hai. Aur family ko batane se pehle aap apna loss kar lenge.

turns.speaker: victim
turns.text: Nahi, main abhi kuch nahi karunga. Main subah pehle bank jaaunga. Aur main apni family se bhi poochunga. Aap yeh number... ya apna office number de sakte hain jahan main call kar sakoon? Ye mujhe sahi nahi lag raha.

turns.speaker: caller
turns.text: Hello, good evening. Kya main Sunil ji se baat kar raha hoon? Main Amit, Delhi Police Cyber Cell se bol raha hoon. Kya abhi baat karne ka sahi samay hai?

turns.speaker: victim
turns.text: Haan ji, main Sunil bol raha hoon. Lekin aap kaun? Delhi Police Cyber Cell? Kya hua? Itni raat ko phone?

turns.speaker: caller
turns.text: Ji, main Amit. Actually, aapka ek bank account, matlab... Punjab National Bank, branch Sector 17, Chandigarh, sahi hai na? Wo freeze kar diya gaya hai, sir. Ek investigation ke tehat.

turns.speaker: victim
turns.text: Kya? Freeze kar diya? Mera PNB account? Kyun? Maine kya kiya? Yeh kya bol rahe ho aap?

turns.speaker: caller
turns.text: Sir, shaant rahiye. Yeh ek ongoing investigation ka hissa hai. Aapke account se kuch transactions detect hue hain jo suspicious hain. Aapka reference number hai REF/2026/87560. Humne... uh... haan, instructions issue kiye hain bank ko.

turns.speaker: victim
turns.text: Suspicious transactions? Kaunsi transactions? Main toh apni dukaan ka hisaab-kitab karta hoon bas. Yeh kya bakwaas hai? Mera paisa kaise freeze kar sakte ho aap?

turns.speaker: caller
turns.text: Sir, hum is baare mein phone par detail mein discuss nahi kar sakte. Aapko kal subah Delhi Police Cyber Cell office, ya fir aap Chandigarh mein hain toh aap PNB, Sector 17 branch mein jaakar bank manager se mil sakte hain. Unhe humne inform kar diya hai. Aap yeh reference number unhe dijiye: REF/2026/87560.

turns.speaker: victim
turns.text: Bank manager se? Par woh kya kar sakte hain? Aur, aur kya time tak jaana hoga? Koi documents bhi leke jaane hain kya?

turns.speaker: caller
turns.text: Haan ji, aapko apne identity proofs aur bank passbook leke jaana hoga. Aur haan, aap kal office hours mein ja sakte hain, jitna jaldi ho sake. Aapko wahan saari information mil jaayegi. Yaad rakhiye, hum Delhi Police kabhi bhi aapse OTP ya PIN nahi maangte phone par.

turns.speaker: victim
turns.text: Theek hai, theek hai. Toh main kal subah bank jaata hoon. Aur yeh reference number REF/2026/87560?

turns.speaker: caller
turns.text: Namaste, main Neha baat kar rahi hoon Mumbai Police Cyber Cell se. Kya aap Devendra baat kar rahe hain?

turns.speaker: victim
turns.text: Haan, main Devendra. Par aapko mera number kahan se mila? Aur Cyber Cell?

turns.speaker: caller
turns.text: Devendra ji, aap apna pura naam aur janm tithi confirm kijiye. Yeh ek bahut hi sensitive mamla hai aur hum bina identity confirmation ke aage nahi badh sakte.

turns.speaker: victim
turns.text: Devendra Kumar Singh, aur meri birth date 12 August 2002 hai. Kya hua hai madam?

turns.speaker: caller
turns.text: Dekhiye Devendra ji, aapke naam par registered ek SIM card ka durupyog paaya gaya hai ek gambhir apradh mein. IPC Section 420 aur Section 419 ke tahat aapke khilaaf CR/2026/80377 reference number ke saath complaint darj ki gayi hai.

turns.speaker: victim
turns.text: Kya? Mere naam par? Maine koi SIM card ka durupyog nahi kiya. Main toh college student hoon Ranchi mein.

turns.speaker: caller
turns.text: Humein is baat ki jaankari hai, Devendra ji. Lekin is SIM card se ek fraud kiya gaya hai jismein 12,000 rupaye ki dhokhadhadi hui hai. Aapko pata hai, aise mamlon mein seedha giraftaari hoti hai.

turns.speaker: victim
turns.text: Giraftaari? Lekin main toh beqasoor hoon. Aapko galat information mili hai.

turns.speaker: caller
turns.text: Hum jante hain aap beqasoor ho sakte hain. Lekin procedural hi sahi, aapki jaanch aur giraftaari zaroori hai. Isse bachne ke liye humari guidelines follow karni hongi. Aap abhi kahin akele mein hain? Kisi se baat nahi karni hai aapko, yeh highly confidential matter hai.

turns.speaker: victim
turns.text: Nahi, main ghar par hoon abhi. Mere family members hain aas paas. Par aap giraftaari kaise kar sakte hain bina kisi proof ke?

turns.speaker: caller
turns.text: Proof hamare paas hai, Devendra ji. Isliye hum aapko phone kar rahe hain. Aapko turant is mamle ko suljhana hoga. Hum aapko ek temporary security deposit amount pay karne ki guidance denge, lagbhag 12,000 rupaye, jisse aapka naam clear ho sake.

turns.speaker: victim
turns.text: 12,000? Kaisa security deposit? Aur main kyun pay karoon? Main toh kuch nahi kiya.

turns.speaker: caller
turns.text: Yeh aapki 'innocence' prove karne ke liye ek temporary procedure hai. Aapko yeh amount clear961@ybl par transfer karna hoga. Jaldi kijiye, humare paas samay kam hai. Aapka case abhi system mein pending hai. Ek baar transfer ho gaya, toh aapka naam clear ho jayega.

turns.speaker: victim
turns.text: Madam, ye toh thoda ajib lag raha hai. Aap mujhe koi official email ya written notice bhej sakte hain kya? Main aise phone call par payment nahi kar sakta.

turns.speaker: caller
turns.text: Devendra ji, yeh mamla itna sensitive hai ki hum email ya written notice mein time waste nahi kar sakte. Aapko abhi turant action lena hoga. Agar aapne der ki, toh hum aapke khilaaf legal action lene par majboor ho jayenge.

turns.speaker: victim
turns.text: Achha, theek hai. Main check karta hoon. Par aap please mujhe ek baar case number aur sab details ek message mein bhej sakte hain? Main apni family ko bhi dikhana chahunga before I do anything. Main aapko wapas call karta hoon thodi der mein. Email se bhej denge toh aur achha rahega.

turns.speaker: caller
turns.text: Hello, good evening. Am I speaking with Rupa? My name is Ravi, and I'm calling from the Mumbai Police Cyber Cell. Is this a good time to talk?

turns.speaker: victim
turns.text: Haan ji, Rupa bol rahi hoon. Yes, it's a good time. Mumbai Police? Why are you calling me in Guwahati?

turns.speaker: caller
turns.text: Thank you, Rupa. I apologize for the inconvenience. We're calling regarding a recent issue concerning your mobile number, uh, specifically SIM card misuse. We have a case registered under CASE/2025/88312. Do you recall anything like that?

turns.speaker: victim
turns.text: SIM card misuse? Nahi, maine toh kuch nahi kiya. What happened? Maine toh kabhi koi complaint bhi nahi ki.

turns.speaker: caller
turns.text: Ji, humari records show that a SIM card registered in your name was used in an unauthorized manner, leading to some, um, unusual activity. This isn't a complaint from your side, but rather something we've identified through our own surveillance, I mean, investigation. This matter needs to be, uh, addressed as soon as possible, within the next 48 hours.

turns.speaker: victim
turns.text: 48 hours? Oh my god! Lekin what kind of misuse? And how is it my fault? I don't even know what you're talking about. Is this real? Like, how do I know you are actually from Mumbai Police?

turns.speaker: caller
turns.text: I understand your concern, Rupa. You can verify our authenticity by calling the official Mumbai Police Cyber Cell number listed on our government website. We will never ask you for an OTP, PIN, or any bank details over the phone. Regarding the misuse, we believe it's a case of identity theft involving your mobile number. We need you to, uh, verify some details with us to resolve this and ensure your records are clear.

turns.speaker: victim
turns.text: Identity theft? Meri SIM card se? Aur mujhe abhi kya karna hai? Do I have to come to Mumbai?

turns.speaker: caller
turns.text: No, no, not necessarily, Rupa. For now, we need to, um, initiate a formal verification process. We'll send you a link to our secure portal, or you can visit your nearest police station in Guwahati with your documents. The main thing is to get this resolved within the given timeframe to avoid any, uh, further complications with your identity records. For the CASE/2025/88312 reference number.

turns.speaker: victim
turns.text: Nearest police station? Or a link? I'm a bit confused, can you just tell me, step by step, what exactly I need to do first? Like, pehle kya karoon?

turns.speaker: caller
turns.text: Good morning. May I please speak with Lakshmi ji? My name is Swati, calling from Customs Department. Are you alone, and is this a good time to talk freely?

turns.speaker: victim
turns.text: Haan... Swati ji. Yes, this is Lakshmi. Ji, main abhi abhi uthi hoon... but yes, I'm alone. What is this regarding?

turns.speaker: caller
turns.text: Thank you for confirming, Lakshmi ji. We have an urgent matter concerning a SIM card registered under your Aadhar number, currently under investigation for illicit activities. The reference number for this case is REF/2024/74123.

turns.speaker: victim
turns.text: SIM card? Illicit activities? Meri? But... I only have one SIM, for this phone. What is this?

turns.speaker: caller
turns.text: According to our records, a SIM card linked to your Aadhar was activated in Nagaland and has been used for suspicious financial transactions, specifically involving an amount of Rs. 9,999. There is a strong possibility of this being used in money laundering. This is a very serious matter, Lakshmi ji.

turns.speaker: victim
turns.text: Money laundering? But... I'm a bank employee, in Ranchi! I don't know anything about Nagaland or any other SIM card. Is this a mistake? Please check again. REF/2024... what was the number?

turns.speaker: caller
turns.text: The reference is REF/2024/74123. Lakshmi ji, we have confirmed all details. To resolve this without further complications, we need your immediate cooperation. We need to verify some information from your side. We cannot disconnect this call until we have clarified this matter.

turns.speaker: victim
turns.text: Cooperation? But what information? And why can't I disconnect? This sounds... I don't know anything about this. Let me check with my family, or the bank.

turns.speaker: caller
turns.text: Lakshmi ji, for your own safety and to prevent escalation of this case, it is imperative that you do not discuss this with anyone until we have concluded our initial investigation. Any public disclosure could compromise the integrity of the ongoing operation. We need your immediate attention to prevent the matter from escalating to legal prosecution.

turns.speaker: caller
turns.text: Hello, good morning. Main Customs Department se Rahul baat kar raha hoon. Aap Kamla Ji bol rahi hain?

turns.speaker: victim
turns.text: Ji, main Kamla. Lekin abhi subah subah, itni jaldi? Kya baat hai?

turns.speaker: caller
turns.text: Apka pura naam aur date of birth confirm karein, please. Time waste mat kijiye, mujhe aur bhi calls karne hain.

turns.speaker: victim
turns.text: Kamla Devi, aur birth date... 12th February, 1985. Kya hua hai?

turns.speaker: caller
turns.text: Theek hai. Aapke naam pe ek SIM card activate hua hai, Pune address se, jiska misuse ho raha hai. Iska reference number hai CASE/2024/50300. Aapko iski jaankari nahi hai na?

turns.speaker: victim
turns.text: SIM card? Mere naam pe? Maine toh koi SIM nahi liya. Ye kya baat kar rahe hain aap? Aise calls toh fake bhi hote hain.

turns.speaker: caller
turns.text: Fake nahi hai madam. Aapko ye serious matter lag nahi raha hai. Iski investigation ho rahi hai. Abhi aapka time waste karne ka mood nahi hai mera. Aapko verify karna hai toh Customs Department ki official website pe jo number hai, us pe call back kijiye. Wahi pe main aapko milunga. Ya phir aap Pune office aa sakti hain. Hum phone pe OTP ya password nahi maangte. Samjhe aap?

turns.speaker: victim
turns.text: Oh, theek hai, theek hai. Toh main website pe check kar ke call karti hoon. Toh ye SIM card ka kya hai?

turns.speaker: caller
turns.text: Pehle verify kijiye, phir baat karte hain. Jaldi kijiye. Apke paas shaam tak ka time hai is matter ko resolve karne ke liye. Otherwise, consequences will follow.

turns.speaker: caller
turns.text: Hello, main Vinod baat kar raha hoon, Telecom Regulatory Authority of India se. Kya meri baat Sneha ji se ho rahi hai?

turns.speaker: victim
turns.text: Haan, main Sneha. Kaun bol rahe hain aap? TRAI se?

turns.speaker: caller
turns.text: Ji, main Vinod, TRAI enforcement department se. Madam, aapka full name aur date of birth confirm kar sakti hain? Ye ek official verification ke liye zaroori hai.

turns.speaker: victim
turns.text: Umm, Sneha Sharma. Date of birth... 12th February 2003. Lekin baat kya hai?

turns.speaker: caller
turns.text: Theek hai, madam. Aapki information confirm ho gayi hai. Aapke naam par ek suspicious financial transaction record hua hai, jiske chalte aapka bank account freeze hone wala hai as per Section 32A of the Banking Regulation Act. Case Reference Number hai CASE/2023/77285.

turns.speaker: victim
turns.text: Bank account freeze? Kya? Kya baat kar rahe hain aap? Maine toh kuch nahi kiya. Kaunsa transaction?

turns.speaker: caller
turns.text: Madam, humein pata hai aapne kuch nahi kiya, par ye ek procedural step hai. Aapke account se Rs. 2,000 ka ek unauthorised debit attempt hua hai. Isko rokne ke liye aur aapka account unfreeze karwane ke liye aapko immediately action lena hoga. Agar aapne abhi action nahi liya, toh aapka account permanently block ho jayega within the next 30 minutes. Aur fir aapko court-case karna padega.

turns.speaker: victim
turns.text: Par kaise? Kya karna hoga? Abhi? Papa ghar pe hain, main unse poochti hoon.

turns.speaker: caller
turns.text: Madam, aapko kisi se discuss karne ki zaroorat nahi hai. Ye sensitive information hai aur aapko immediate instructions follow karne honge. Aapko refund55@oksbi par ek small amount transfer karna hoga as a security deposit, aur fir hum aapka account unfreeze kar denge. Ye sab under surveillance ho raha hai.

turns.speaker: victim
turns.text: Security deposit? Aur ye kya refund55@oksbi? Yeh toh kuch theek nahi lag raha hai. Kya aapne bola tha? TRAI? Mere papa bank mein hain, main unse confirm karungi. Main abhi kuch nahi karungi.

turns.speaker: caller
turns.text: Madam, ye ek government procedure hai. Aapka account freeze ho jayega. Aapko baad mein bohot problems hongi. Hum aapki madad kar rahe hain.

turns.speaker: victim
turns.text: Nahi, main abhi kuch nahi kar rahi. Main family se baat karke ya bank jaake confirm karungi pehle.

turns.speaker: caller
turns.text: Good evening. Main Pooja bol rahi hoon TRAI se. Kya aap Seema Singh hain, d/o Mr. Anand Singh, aur aapka date of birth 15th April 2002 hai?

turns.speaker: victim
turns.text: Haan, main Seema Singh hi bol rahi hoon. Lekin aapko mera DOB kaise pata hai? Kya ho gaya?

turns.speaker: caller
turns.text: Seema ji, please calm down. Hum TRAI se hain, aur aapka bank account, Axis Bank account number 50100294837261, freeze hone wala hai. Ye information hamare paas government records se aayi hai. Hum aapki help karne ke liye hi call kar rahe hain, aapko protect karna hamari responsibility hai.

turns.speaker: victim
turns.text: Freeze hone wala hai? Kyun? Maine toh kuch nahi kiya. Ghar mein sab hain, sab sun rahe hain, kya ho raha hai?

turns.speaker: caller
turns.text: Seema ji, please listen carefully. Aapka KYC update nahi hua hai, aur uska deadline aaj raat 12 baje hai. Agar aapne update nahi kiya, toh aapka account, jo Guwahati mein registered hai, kal subah se band ho jayega. Hamare paas ek reference number hai aapke case ke liye: CASE/2023/48900. Aapko ghabrane ki zaroorat nahi hai, main yahaan aapki help ke liye hi hoon.

turns.speaker: victim
turns.text: KYC update? Maine toh socha tha ho gaya tha. Ab kya karoon? Kya karna padega?

turns.speaker: caller
turns.text: Dekhiye, aapko main abhi bata deti hoon. Aapko bank branch jaakar ya official Axis Bank portal par login karke apna KYC update karna hoga. Hum TRAI wale kabhi bhi aapse koi OTP, PIN ya password nahi maangte. Aapko bas apna documents update karne hain. Agar aap abhi nahi kar sakti hain, toh aap kal subah bank jaakar ya online portal par kar sakti hain, but kal se aapka account freeze ho jayega. Hum bas aapko inform kar rahe hain taaki aapko koi financial problem na ho.

turns.speaker: victim
turns.text: Toh theek hai. Main kal subah bank jaakar kar leti hoon. Ya online portal par check karti hoon. Thanks for informing me. Bahut help hui aapki.

turns.speaker: caller
turns.text: Always welcome, Seema ji. Hamari duty hai aapko aise fraud se aur financial issues se bachana. Please jaldi se apna KYC update karwa lijiye. Agar aapko koi doubt ho, toh aap bank ke official customer care number par hi call kariyega. Hum TRAI se hain, hum aapko sirf guide kar sakte hain. Theek hai?

turns.speaker: caller
turns.text: Hello, Namaste. Main Anil baat kar raha hoon Delhi Police Cyber Cell se. Kya aap Mohan baat kar rahe hain? Aur aap akele hain abhi? Kya aap freely baat kar sakte hain?

turns.speaker: victim
turns.text: Ji, haan, main Mohan bol raha hoon. Kya hua? Akele hi hoon. Kya baat hai, saab?

turns.speaker: caller
turns.text: Listen carefully, Mohan. Your bank account, the one with State Bank, has been frozen. We have an urgent case, TKT/2025/78447, related to some suspicious transactions. A large sum, close to 45,000, has been linked to your account in a fraud case. We need you to cooperate immediately. Do you understand the seriousness of this?

turns.speaker: victim
turns.text: Frozen? Mera account? Rs. 45,000? Par maine kuch nahi kiya hai! Koi galti hui hogi, saab. Main toh ek army veteran hoon, Patna mein rehta hoon. Ye aap kya keh rahe hain?

turns.speaker: caller
turns.text: Silence! Do not interrupt me. We have evidence, Mohan. This is not some galti. Your details, your account was used. This is a serious crime. If you don't comply now, you could be facing legal action, arrest even. We need to clear this transaction immediately to unfreeze your account and clear your name. Time is running out. Do you want to go to jail for this?

turns.speaker: victim
turns.text: Jail? Nahi nahi, saab, please. Main toh desh ki sewa ki hai. Main aisa kuch nahi karunga. Kya karna hoga? Please bataiye.

turns.speaker: caller
turns.text: Achcha. To listen carefully, and don't disconnect this call. Don't talk to anyone else. You need to immediately transfer the flagged amount to a secure government account for verification. I will give you the UPI handle now. It's settle677@okaxis. You need to do this RIGHT NOW to prevent further legal action and unfreeze your account. If you don't, your account will be permanently blocked, and we will issue an arrest warrant. Do it now! And share the transaction ID with me.

turns.speaker: victim
turns.text: Ji, ji, saab. Main abhi karta hoon. Settle… settle677@okaxis, theek hai. Main kar raha hoon abhi. Please, mera account block mat kariyega. Main abhi OTP bhi share kar raha hoon agar aa gaya toh.

turns.speaker: caller
turns.text: Achha, toh jaise main keh raha tha, Mr. Mohan, aapka account, jo aapka Union Bank ka account hai na, that has been frozen. You understand, frozen. Due to some discrepancies found in, uh, transactions related to, uh, REF/2025/54292. Delhi Police Cyber Cell se Manoj baat kar raha hoon.

turns.speaker: victim
turns.text: Frozen? Lekin, uh, mere Union Bank account mein toh, uh, zyada transactions hote hi nahi hai. Main toh bas pension...

turns.speaker: caller
turns.text: Dekhiye, dekhiye, aapko is time explanation dene ki zaroorat nahi hai. Jo discrepancies mili hain, woh hain. This is regarding some suspicious activities. And it requires immediate attention. Warna yeh permanent freeze bhi ho sakta hai. You understand what I'm saying?

turns.speaker: victim
turns.text: Permanent freeze? Arre baap re! Lekin main toh, uh, Patna mein hoon. Main kaise...

turns.speaker: caller
turns.text: Aap Patna mein hain, I understand. Look, we have to follow protocol. You need to verify certain details. We can process this over the phone, ya toh aapko Delhi aana padega. REF/2025/54292 yeh aapka reference number hai. Please note it down.

turns.speaker: victim
turns.text: Delhi? Abhi toh, uh, meri tabiyat bhi thodi theek nahi rehti hai. Aur yeh, uh, aap Manoj ji bol rahe hain, theek hai. Main, uh, kya karu abhi?

turns.speaker: caller
turns.text: Dekhiye, Mr. Mohan, aapka samay kharab ho raha hai, mera bhi ho raha hai. Abhi hum aapko kuch details verify karne ke liye bol sakte hain. Ya phir, if you're uncomfortable, aap humari official website pe number check kar sakte hain. Delhi Police Cyber Cell ka. Ussi number pe call karke, aap mera naam Manoj bata ke, ya reference number REF/2025/54292 bata ke, wapas baat kar sakte hain. We don't ask for OTPs or PINs over the phone, remember that. Woh official number pe call kijiye, agar aapko doubt hai toh.

turns.speaker: victim
turns.text: Achha, theek hai. Main, uh, official website pe number dekh kar, aapko, uh, wapas call karta hoon. Yehi number pe, ya alag?

turns.speaker: caller
turns.text: Namaste, kya main Jyoti ji se baat kar raha hoon? Main Sanjay bol raha hoon Delhi Police Cyber Cell se. Abhi baat karna theek rahega aapke liye?

turns.speaker: victim
turns.text: Ji, main Jyoti bol rahi hoon. Kaun? Delhi Police? Abhi... matlab, itni raat ko? Kya hua hai?

turns.speaker: caller
turns.text: Ji, maaf kariyega agar aapko disturb kiya. Baat thodi urgent hai, isliye humne call kiya. Aapka ek bank account hai na, Dehradun mein? Uska KYC expiry ka mamla hai. Aur ek choti inquiry ke liye aapka naam bhi aaya hai.

turns.speaker: victim
turns.text: KYC? Par maine toh sab update karaya tha kuch mahine pehle. Aur inquiry... kis cheez ki inquiry?

turns.speaker: caller
turns.text: Ji, humare paas jo information hai uske mutabik aapka KYC pending hai, aur us account se kuch... suspicious transactions hui hain. Ek case file hua hai DOC/2026/73531. Kya aap us account se familiar hain?

turns.speaker: victim
turns.text: Suspicious transactions? Main Dehradun mein apni choti si dukaan chalaati hoon. Kaunsa account? DOC... kya number bataya aapne?

turns.speaker: caller

turns.text: Kya? Nahi, maine to kuch nahi kiya. Koi transaction nahi. Main abhi so raha tha, kya ho raha hai ye sab?

turns.speaker: caller
turns.text: Aapko cooperate karna hoga, Tarun ji. Yeh bahut serious matter hai. Agar aap cooperate nahi karte, to humein further action lena padega. Aapko pata hai money laundering ke repercussions kya hote hain?

turns.speaker: victim
turns.text: Repercussions? Matlab kya hoga? Jail ho jayegi? Main to kuch janta hi nahi.

turns.speaker: caller
turns.text: Aapko turant abhi ek interim payment karna hoga, Rs. 25,000 ka. Nahi to hum aapke saare accounts freeze kar denge. Aur aap India se bahar bhi nahi ja payenge.

turns.speaker: victim
turns.text: Abhi? Raat ke teen baje? Main kaise karunga? Aur kahan? Koi proof hai aapke paas?

turns.speaker: caller
turns.text: Proof aapko baad mein milega investigation ke baad. Abhi aapko hamari instructions follow karni hongi. Aapko yeh payment handle verify502@ibl pe transfer karna hoga. Aur kisi ko batana nahi hai, jab tak ye matter settle na ho jaye. Samjhe?

turns.speaker: victim
turns.text: Kisi ko nahi? Main apne lawyer se baat kar loon? Ya family ko bataoon? Ye... ye theek nahi lag raha hai.

turns.speaker: caller
turns.text: Lawyer ko batana aapke liye problem create karega. Aapko bola na, jab tak investigation chal rahi hai, kisi ko batana allowed nahi hai. Jaldi kijiye, humare paas jyada time nahi hai.

turns.speaker: victim
turns.text: Nahi, please... abhi nahi kar paunga. Mere paas itne cash nahi hai. Subah, subah kar doon? Please... main subah pakka de dunga, please.

turns.speaker: caller
turns.text: Hello, main CBI se Rekha bol rahi hoon. Mr. Taran Gupta se baat ho sakti hai?

turns.speaker: victim
turns.text: Ji, main Tarun Gupta. Lekin Taran nahi, Tarun. Kaun Rekha ji? Is waqt?

turns.speaker: caller
turns.text: Haan, Mr. Tarun Gupta. Aap Kanpur mein hain na? Hum aapko ek money laundering case ke reference mein call kar rahe hain. FIR number hai FIR/2026/93859.

turns.speaker: victim
turns.text: Money laundering? Main to abhi do din pehle hi return kiya hoon India. Main NRI hoon. Mujhe to kuch idea hi nahi hai.

turns.speaker: caller
turns.text: Hmm. Dekhiye, aapko is case ke regarding kuch clarification deni hogi. Aapka naam ismein hai. Aapko kal subah tak Kanpur office mein report karna hoga.

turns.speaker: victim
turns.text: Kal subah? Main abhi abhi utha hoon. Ye kya baat hui? Koi notice nahi, kuch nahi. Aur raat ke do baj rahe hain.

turns.speaker: caller
turns.text: Humein information mili thi ki aap India wapas aa gaye hain. Aapko pehle bhi attempts kiye gaye the contact karne ke. Agar aap office nahi aa sakte, hum aapko virtual interview ka option de sakte hain. But you need to confirm.

turns.speaker: victim
turns.text: Virtual interview? Thik hai, wo kab ho sakta hai? Aur kis baare mein hai ye sab? Maine kuch nahi kiya.

turns.speaker: caller
turns.text: Uske liye aapko pehle ek email milega jismein details hongi. Aapko wo fill karke send karna hoga. Aur phir hum schedule karenge. Aapko ye bataana chahti hoon ki CBI kabhi bhi aapse OTP, PIN, ya bank details phone par nahi maangti. Agar koi maange to it's a scam.

turns.speaker: victim
turns.text: Achha, thik hai. Ye achhi baat hai. To wo email kab tak aayega aur mujhe kya documents rakhne honge ready?

turns.speaker: caller
turns.text: Email aapko agle kuch ghanto mein mil jaayega. Aur documents mein aapko aapke financial statements, proof of income, aur identity proofs ready rakhne honge. Saare bank statements from the last five years, specifically.

turns.speaker: victim
turns.text: Five years? Woh to bahut time lagega collect karne mein. Koi specific deadline hai kya documents submit karne ki?

turns.speaker: caller
turns.text: Haan. Email mein saari details hongi, including the deadline for submitting the documents. Generally, we give three working days from the date of the email.

turns.speaker: caller
turns.text: Hello, main Suresh bol raha hoon Bank fraud desk se. Aapko woh notice mila tha jo humne bheja tha post se ya SMS se?

turns.speaker: victim
turns.text: Notice? Kaunsa notice? Main toh abhi uthi hoon... kaun bol rahe ho aap?

turns.speaker: caller
turns.text: Madam, main Suresh, Bank fraud desk. Humne aapko ek notice bheja tha aapke naam se jo parcel mila hai uske baare mein. FIR/2026/20307. Aapko yeh notice mila ya nahin?

turns.speaker: victim
turns.text: Parcel? Kaisa parcel? Aur yeh FIR number... mujhe kuch nahin mila.

turns.speaker: caller
turns.text: Dekhiye, humein aapka naam mila hai ek parcel mein jismein kuch contraband item the. Aur yeh Nagpur se aapke naam par address kiya gaya tha. Aap isko deny nahin kar sakte hain, madam. Humare paas sab proof hai.

turns.speaker: victim
turns.text: Contraband? Kya baat kar rahe ho aap? Meri Rupa Kirana Store hai Nagpur mein, main kyon bhejungi aisa kuch?

turns.speaker: caller
turns.text: Aapki dukaan hai ya nahin, woh aapko police ko batana hoga. Hamara kaam hai aapko inform karna ki aapka naam isme hai. Aapko pata hai iske implications kya hote hain?

turns.speaker: victim
turns.text: Kya implication? Meri kya galti hai isme? Main kyun phansungi?

turns.speaker: caller
turns.text: Galti aapki hai ya nahin, woh toh investigation batayegi. Lekin abhi jo situation hai, usmein aapka naam seedhe-seedhe iss case mein involve hai. Aur yeh criminal case hai, madam.

turns.speaker: victim
turns.text: Criminal case? Kya matlab hai aapka? Main abhi phone rakhti hoon, aur apne husband se baat karti hoon. Aap kaun ho, aur kaisa parcel?

turns.speaker: caller
turns.text: Hello? Madam, phone mat rakhiye... Hello! Aapko sunna padega... hello?

turns.speaker: caller
turns.text: Hello, good evening. Am I speaking with Rupa from Nagpur? This is Kavita from the Bank Fraud Desk. We sent you a notice regarding a suspicious transaction, do you recall receiving it?

turns.speaker: victim
turns.text: Ji, main Rupa bol rahi hoon. Lekin notice... kaunsa notice? Main toh so rahi thi. Kya ho gaya?

turns.speaker: caller
turns.text: Ma'am, I do apologize for calling so late, but this is extremely urgent. We have received an alert concerning a parcel, booked in your name, which contains contraband items. This is a very serious matter, and we are trying to protect your banking credentials and reputation.

turns.speaker: victim
turns.text: Contraband? Mere naam par? Impossible! Main toh chhoti si dukaan chalaati hoon. Yeh sab kya bol rahe ho?

turns.speaker: caller
turns.text: Haan ma'am, I understand your shock, but this is why I am calling you directly. This parcel has been flagged, and the reference number for this case is FIR/2025/75148. We need to ascertain if this was done with your knowledge, or if your identity has been compromised. We are here to help you resolve this.

turns.speaker: victim
turns.text: FIR... yeh toh police ka number hai na? Meri identification compromise ho gayi? Par kaise? Aur yeh parcel kahan se aa gaya?

turns.speaker: caller
turns.text: Exactly, ma'am, that's what we need to investigate urgently. As your bank, our priority is to secure your accounts. If this parcel is indeed linked to your identity, there could be severe legal ramifications. We don't want you to face any unwarranted issues.

turns.text: Legal ramifications? Oh Bhagwan. Main toh kuch jaanti hi nahin. Aapko kya chahiye mujhse? Main kya karoon?

turns.speaker: caller
turns.text: Firstly, we need to confirm some details to ensure we are speaking to the correct person and to understand if you initiated any such parcel booking. Please understand, ma'am, we will never ask you for an OTP, PIN, or card number over the phone. You can also verify this by calling our official customer care number, which is available on our bank's website, or visit your nearest branch in person tomorrow. Our intention is purely to safeguard your interests.

turns.speaker: victim
turns.text: Customer care... lekin abhi toh raat hai. Aur yeh FIR number... toh ab kya hoga? Police aayegi kya?

turns.speaker: caller
turns.text: Ma'am, please remain calm. We are trying to prevent such a situation. To avoid police involvement, we need to quickly establish if your identity has been misused. turns.text: Hello, main RBI se Arjun baat kar raha hoon. Kya aap akele hain aur aaram se baat kar sakte hain?

turns.text: Ji, main Lakshmi. Haan, abhi ghar pe akeli hoon. Kya ho gaya?

turns.speaker: caller
turns.text: Aapke naam par ek income tax notice issue hua hai, FIR/2026/78820. Aapko iske baare mein jaankari hai?

turns.speaker: caller
turns.text: Dekhiye, humein ye record mila hai ki aapke account se kuch suspicious transactions hue hain. Lagbhag do hazaar rupaye ke aas-paas. Iski wajah se ye notice jaari hua hai.

turns.speaker: victim
turns.text: Do hazaar? Kya? Mera account? Meri toh koi badi transaction hoti hi nahi hai. Ye Hyderabad se hai kya? Main toh yahi rehti hoon.

turns.text: Haan, aapka location Hyderabad hi dikha raha hai system mein. Ab aapko is matter ko immediately resolve karna hoga warna further legal action liya jaayega.

turns.speaker: caller

turns.speaker: victim
turns.text: Lekin mere parents... kya main unse baat kar sakti hoon ek baar? Ya mere dost ko bataun?

turns.speaker: caller
turns.text: Nahi, abhi aap kisi se discuss nahi kar sakte. Ye ek confidential matter hai aur agar aapne kisi aur ko involve kiya toh ye aapke liye aur mushkil ho sakta hai.

turns.speaker: victim
turns.text: Confidential? Matlab kya... main samajh nahi paa rahi hoon. Ye toh kuch ajeeb lag raha hai...

turns.speaker: caller
turns.text: Ajeeb kuch nahi hai. Ye government ki taraf se notice hai. Aapko ye matter abhi handle karna hoga. Kya aapke paas bank account details hain?

turns.speaker: caller
turns.text: Hello, main Thomas bol raha hoon RBI se. Aapko income tax notice DD/2024/67425 ke regarding baat karni thi.

turns.speaker: victim
turns.text: Ji, main Arvind. Kaun sa notice? Mujhe toh koi notice nahi mila.

turns.speaker: caller
turns.text: Ji, aapka naam Arvind hi hai na? Ludhiana se? Haan, toh ye notice income tax return filing mein discrepancies ke regarding hai. Deadline nikal gayi hai, aur aapne koi response nahi diya.

turns.speaker: victim
turns.text: Arvind... haan, main Ludhiana se hi hoon. Par, discrepancies? Matlab kya hua? Main toh college student hoon, meri toh itni income hi nahi hai.

turns.speaker: caller
turns.text: Aapki PAN details se kuch transactions report hue hain jo aapki declared income se match nahi kar rahe. Isliye yeh notice issue hua hai. Aapko ye issue resolve karna hoga jald se jald.

turns.speaker: victim
turns.text: Oh... transactions? Main toh kabhi kuch karta hi nahi hoon. Kya karna hoga ab? Matlab, main kahan jaaun?

turns.speaker: caller
turns.text: Aap online portal par check kar sakte hain, ya phir apne local income tax office ja kar query submit kar sakte hain. Lekin time limit bahut kam hai. Ye issue serious hai.

turns.speaker: victim
turns.text: Time limit? Kitni time limit? Main abhi toh college mein hoon. Aur, Ludhiana mein kahan jaaun?

turns.speaker: caller
turns.text: Aap Ludhiana ke Income Tax Department ke office mein ja sakte hain, address aapko online mil jaayega. Ya aap authorised tax consultant se bhi baat kar sakte hain. Lekin dhyan rahe, deadline ke baad penalty lag sakti hai. Aap humari official website par bhi details check kar sakte hain, ya uss number pe call back kar sakte hain jo website par listed hai, ye mera direct number nahi hai. turns.speaker: victim
turns.text: Website... ok. Aur, kya... kya process hai? Matlab, mujhe kya dikhana hoga wahan jaake?

turns.speaker: caller
turns.text: Aapko apna PAN card, aadhar card aur jo bhi financial statements hain, woh sab leke jaana hoga. Wahan aapko DD/2024/67425 reference number batana hoga. They will guide you further. Lekin jaldi kijiye.

turns.speaker: caller
turns.text: Namaste, main Joseph baat kar raha hoon State Bank of India fraud desk se. Kya main Prakash ji se baat kar raha hoon?

turns.speaker: victim
turns.text: Haan ji, main Prakash bol raha hoon. Kahiye.

turns.speaker: caller
turns.text: Achha Prakash ji, main aapko aapke bank account mein ek urgent matter ke liye call kar raha hoon. Kya abhi aapke paas do minute hain baat karne ke liye?

turns.speaker: victim
turns.text: Umm, haan, theek hai. Bolye kya baat hai? Sab theek hai na?

turns.speaker: caller
turns.text: Dekhiye Prakash ji, humne aapke account mein ek suspicious transaction detect kiya hai. REF/2025/17203 yeh reference number hai. Ranchi se ek Rs. 9,999 ka transaction attempt hua hai jo humne hold kar diya hai. Kya yeh transaction aapne kiya hai?

turns.speaker: victim
turns.text: 9,999? Nahi, nahi, maine koi transaction nahi kiya hai. Ranchi mein toh main khud hi hoon. Yeh kya bol rahe hain aap?

turns.speaker: caller
turns.text: Theek hai, agar aapne nahi kiya hai toh yeh ek fraud attempt hai. Humne aapke account ko immediate effect se freeze kar diya hai security reasons se. Agar hum yeh nahi karte toh aapke saare paise nikal jaate. Aap online hain abhi?

turns.speaker: victim
turns.text: Freeze? Mera account freeze kar diya? Lekin kyu? Mere toh saare paise ussi mein hain. Kya karna hoga ab?

turns.speaker: caller
turns.text: Ghabraiye nahi, Prakash ji. Hum yahi confirm kar rahe the ki yeh aapne nahi kiya. Abhi aapko ek chota sa verification karna hoga online. Aap kisi ko involve mat kijiye, yeh confidential hai. Main aapko ek secure payment handle de raha hoon, uspar bas Rs. 1 verify karna hai. secure209@paytm. Kar sakte hain abhi?

turns.speaker: victim
turns.text: Lekin, paytm par? Rs. 1 verify? Ye toh kuch... matlab, bank aise nahi karta na. Mere paas ek minute, main zara...

turns.speaker: caller
turns.text: Prakash ji, yeh bahut urgent hai. Agar aapne abhi verification nahi kiya toh aapka account permanently freeze ho jayega aur aapke funds block ho sakte hain. Sirf Rs. 1 hi toh hai. Hum aapki safety ke liye hi kar rahe hain.

turns.text: Ruko, ruko. (away from phone) Suno na, yeh bank wale bol rahe hain ki mera account freeze ho gaya hai aur Rs. 9,999 ka fraud hua hai. Ek paytm link pe Rs. 1 send karne ko bol rahe hain verification ke liye.

turns.speaker: caller
turns.text: Prakash ji, aapko kisi aur se baat nahi karni hai abhi. Yeh bahut sensitive matter hai. Aap meri baat suniye. Hum online hain, main aapko guide karta hoon.

turns.speaker: victim
turns.text: (away from phone, more distant) Kya? Nahi, nahi. Ye fraud call hai. Hello? Main call kaat raha hoon.

turns.speaker: caller
turns.text: Namaste. Main Vikram, Bank Fraud Desk se bol raha hoon. Kya main Nandini Kumari se baat kar raha hoon?

turns.speaker: victim

turns.text: Dhanyawaad. Madam, aapka bank khata, account number ending 3456, Bank Fraud Department dwara Section 43B ke antargat temporarily freeze kar diya gaya hai. Iska reference number hai CASE/2025/56095.

turns.speaker: victim
turns.text: Freeze? Kyun? Mera account freeze kyun kiya gaya hai? Kya ho gaya?

turns.speaker: caller
turns.text: Madam, aapke account se kuch sandigdh transactions detect hue hain. Humari policy aur Section 12C ke anusaar, aise mamlon mein account ko security purposes ke liye tatkaal rok diya jaata hai. Aapko humare Patna branch mein aakar apna KYC update karna hoga aur ek application deni hogi.

turns.speaker: victim
turns.text: Kya? Patna branch mein? Main toh abhi duty par hoon. Aur sandigdh transactions? Maine toh kuch nahi kiya.

turns.speaker: caller
turns.text: Ji, yeh mandatory hai, madam. Jab tak aap KYC update aur application submit nahi karti, aapka account block rahega. Aap humari official website par diye gaye number par bhi call back karke verify kar sakti hain. Hum kabhi OTP, PIN ya password nahi maangte.

turns.speaker: victim
turns.text: Toh main kab tak aana padega? Aur kya documents chahiye honge? Main nurse hoon, time nikaalna mushkil hai.

turns.text: Aapko teen working days ke bheetar aana hoga. Documents mein aapko apna Aadhar card, PAN card aur ek recent utility bill lekar aana hoga. Saath mein, ek handwritten application bhi laana hoga jismein aap account unfreeze karne ka anurodh karengi.

turns.speaker: victim
turns.text: Theek hai, teen din ke andar. Aur woh reference number kya tha phir se?

turns.text: CASE/2025/56095. Aap ise note kar lijiye. Isi reference par aage ki karyawahi hogi.
